provider.name: synthetic-gold-projection-v1
provider.description: Ranks gold identifiers and deterministic noise without reading document content; used only to validate scoring, matrix coverage and default guardrails.

metricDefinitions.recallAt5: Relevant gold document fraction in the first five ranks.
metricDefinitions.recallAt10: Relevant gold document fraction in the first ten ranks.
metricDefinitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant gold document.
metricDefinitions.evidenceRecall: Only measured when gold_evidence labels are present; otherwise coverage is zero.
metricDefinitions.citationPrecision: Only measured when gold_citations labels are present; otherwise coverage is zero.
metricDefinitions.unsupportedClaimRate: Returned answer with explicitly supplied evidence IDs empty; coverage is zero when no evidence labels are supplied.
metricDefinitions.noAnswerAccuracy: Accuracy over cases explicitly marked expect_no_answer.
metricDefinitions.tokenCost: Deterministic synthetic estimate; not an LLM billing measurement.
metricDefinitions.latency: Deterministic synthetic estimate; not a service latency measurement.

measuredSelection.eligibility: criticalFailures=0, unsupportedClaimRate=0, noAnswerAccuracy=1; vector requires +0.02 MRR, no exact/citation/Recall@10 regression and <=2x latency

productionDefault.reason: Synthetic rankings are not evidence for a production retrieval default; run the API benchmark against captured or real indexed data first.

limitations: This report is a logic-only synthetic execution and makes no retrieval-quality claim.
No private vault, PostgreSQL index, embeddings, graph edges or document content were read.
Evidence recall and citation precision have zero labelled coverage in the current generic fixtures.
Token and latency values are deterministic estimates, not runtime measurements.
Vector-disabled behavior is a pure harness probe; API/index revision integration still requires runtime verification.
The measuredSelection is diagnostic only and must not change the runtime planner or production default.
